lines.t: I’m casting off the skin of this world today
I won't try to shape You into my own way
You told me to die to myself every dawn
So I’m leaving my past on the lawn
No more demanding how You ought to be
I just want to walk with the God who made me
You asked if I long to obey—so I will!
You asked if I want to stay clean—and I will!
I’m dropping the doubt that trips up my feet
Fixing my eyes where Your holiness meets
The face of the Holy One right in my view
Lord, I am running to You
The battle is raging deep in my chest
The desire to sin fighting Truth for my best
But You wrote down my name in the Book of Your Life
Before the foundations, before all this strife
So what is left now for a soul that was bound?
Just the death of my sin on this holy ground
You asked if I long to obey—so I will!
You asked if I want to stay clean—and I will!
I’m dropping the doubt that trips up my feet
Fixing my eyes where Your holiness meets
The face of the Holy One right in my view
Lord, I am running to You
I’m turning a deaf ear to the accuser's old lies
Evil has lost its grip, see how it dies!
The penalty’s over, the passing of death
Is moving inside me with every new breath
You broke every chain that was holding my mind
Leaving the shadows behind
[Guitar Solo / Instrumental Break]
You asked if I long to obey—so I will!
You asked if I want to stay clean—and I will!
I’m dropping the doubt that trips up my feet
Fixing my eyes where Your holiness meets
The face of the Holy One right in my view
Lord, I am running to You
I’m drinking deep from the cup You provide
Giving heed to the speech where the answers abide
Embracing the gift, I am created anew
Redeemed and alive, altogether in You
Created anew...
Yeah, I’m created anew.
[Fade out on a peaceful acoustic strum]
